title: Home pregnancy test
also: how to take a pregnancy test
two lines on a pregnancy test
what: A home test looks for the pregnancy hormone in urine. If it is there, a second line or a sign appears.
why: If your period is late or you think you may be pregnant.
duration: the test itself takes a few minutes; read the result after the time given in the instructions
tell_doctor: The date your last period started
Your test result and when you took it
If you had lower belly pain or bloody spotting

prepare.title: When
prepare.text: It is most accurate from the first day of a missed period. Earlier, the test may not show it yet.

prepare.title: Time of day
prepare.text: Morning is best, with your first urine. It has more hormone.

prepare.title: Water
prepare.text: Do not drink a lot of water before the test. It dilutes the urine.

prepare.title: Instructions
prepare.text: Read the instructions. Different tests have different waiting times.

bring: A test that has not expired
A clean, dry cup, if needed
steps: Wash your hands and open the test right before using it
Hold the tip in your urine stream or dip it in the cup, for as many seconds as the instructions say
Lay the test flat with the window facing up
Wait for the time in the instructions
Read the result. The control line should always appear
feel: Waiting can be nerve-racking. That is normal
after: Two lines, even faint ones, usually mean pregnancy. Make an appointment with a gynecologist
One line but still no period: repeat the test in 2 to 3 days
No control line means the test is faulty. Use a new one
A result that shows up after the time in the instructions does not count
red_flags: A positive test and severe lower belly pain, especially on one side: call emergency services
A positive test with bleeding, weakness, or fainting: call emergency services

faq.q: The second line is very faint. Am I pregnant?
faq.a: Most likely yes. It is just very early. Repeat the test in 2 days or have a blood hCG test.
A negative one can be, if it is too early. A positive one is rarely wrong. Either way, a doctor will confirm.

reminders.text: Pregnancy test tomorrow morning. Use your first morning urine and follow the instructions.
